Sensor Location Characteristic Bits

group CSCS_Sensor_Location

CSC supported Sensor Location characteristic bit mask.

Defines

CSCS_SENS_LOC_OTHER_MASK (1)

Other.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_TOP_OF_SHOE_MASK (1<<1)

Top of shoe.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_IN_SHOE_MASK (1<<2)

In shoe.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_HIP_MASK (1<<3)

Hip.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_FRONT_WHEEL_MASK (1<<4)

Front Wheel.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_LEFT_CRANK_MASK (1<<5)

Left Crank.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_RIGHT_CRANK_MASK (1<<6)

Right Crank.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_LEFT_PEDAL_MASK (1<<7)

Left Pedal.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_RIGHT_PEDAL_MASK (1<<8)

Right Pedal.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_FRONT_HUB_MASK (1<<9)

Front Hub.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_REAR_DROPOUT_MASK (1<<10)

Rear Dropout.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_CHAINSTAY_MASK (1<<11)

Chainstay.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_REAR_WHEEL_MASK (1<<12)

Rear Wheel.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_REAR_HUB_MASK (1<<13)

Rear Hub.

CSCS_SENS_LOC_CHEST_MASK (1<<14)

Chest.

CSCS_ALL_SENS_LOC_SUPPORTED (0x7FFF)

All sensor location are supported.
